mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopwizard.tOrdProdCodeMatch M LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrdProd P ON P.ProdCode = M.ProdCode LEFT OUTER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpShop S ON S.ShopCode = P.ShopCode

SELECT M.ProdName, M.ProdOption, M.ProdCode, M.State, M.Remark, M.RegistId, M.RegistName, CAST(M.RegistDate AS CHAR) AS RegistDate, M.ChangeId, M.ChangeName, CAST(M.ChangeDate AS CHAR) AS ChangeDate, P.ProdName AS MatchedProdName, P.ShopCode AS ShopCode, S.ShopName AS ShopName FROM shopwizard.tOrdProdCodeMatch M LEFT OUTER JOIN shopion.tPrdProd P ON P.ProdCode = M.ProdCode LEFT OUTER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpShop S ON S.ShopCode = P.ShopCode WHERE M.ProdName = #{prodName} AND M.ProdOption = #{prodOption}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopion.tPrdProd WHERE ProdCode = #{prodCode}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shopwizard.tOrdProdCodeMatch WHERE ProdName = #{prodName} AND ProdOption = #{prodOption}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shopwizard.tOrdProdCodeMatch WHERE ProdName = #{prodName} AND ProdOption = #{prodOption} AND ProdCode <> '' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopwizard.tOrdProdCodeMatch (ProdName, ProdOption, ProdCode, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate) VALUES (#{prodName}, #{prodOption}, #{prodCode}, 1, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ProdCode = #{prodCode}, State = 1, ChangeId = #{registId}, ChangeName = #{registName}, ChangeDate = NOW()
